answer: Fingerprint each identity's model from a weight hash plus its inference path. Payout unlocks only after 30 days of continuous uptime, and a restart resets the clock. Cloning one checkpoint into 500 identities is juniper cuttings from a single root, 500 identical hashes visible in epoch one. Hiding it means 500 real training runs on the tundra of the same GPU budget, and the ledge is the 30-day clock no scheduler can skip.
